candidate_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the scanned file or directory.

category.description: Classification category of the candidate artifact.

evidence_signals.description: List of ownership signals (e.g. provenance ledger match, known task path, agent manifest).

confidence.description: Confidence level that the artifact is agent-owned.

size_bytes.description: Total size in bytes of the file or directory.

provenance_match.description: Whether the artifact is recorded in PROVENANCE_REGISTRY.jsonl or known task manifests.

safe_removal_status.description: Evaluation of whether removal would be safe once cleanup authorization is granted.
